verdict.rationale: Otter's pricing page lists "Otter API & Webhooks" as a plan feature, and the Zapier integration and automatic pushes to Airtable/S3 suggest event-driven delivery of meeting data. Beyond that single line, the pack has no documentation of how webhook subscriptions actually work. missing for 10: webhook documentation (event types such as transcript/summary ready, subscription setup, payload schema, signing/verification, retries), plan-tier clarity, independent or hands-on corroboration.
